title: Control switch ledger, 19 Nov 2026
control: play settings v4.0 (169 lines, envs/Vampinity/play-v40.env.txt) plus the two test lines EDEN_TEST_DISCARD_SAVE=1 and EDEN_UP_FAULT_LOG=1

phase4_values.screen: no verdict: screen it (switch it off in a group)
phase4_values.reach first: no verdict, and it may not act on the control at all: a desk reach check before any start
phase4_values.weak verdict: a verdict from one or two starts or an old setup: GBB's call

strength_values.strong: repeated starts or a live A/B with a range
strength_values.medium: 3 against 2 or so, or one clear mechanism
strength_values.weak: one or two starts, an old build or another setup
strength_values.-: no test, or a log or test line

rows.name: EDEN_NX2_TC_LOG
rows.does: Logs each texture decode the game hands off, and when it lands.
rows.verdict_label: kept: needed for the test logs
rows.evidence: log only, changes no behaviour

rows.name: EDEN_HEAP_KEEP_ARENAS
rows.does: The heap keeps memory it has freed instead of handing it back.
rows.evidence: t51-a run202/203 (T51), one start each: largest free block at the end 878 MiB without it, 623 with it; that reason was later marked disproven, nothing since

rows.name: EDEN_NX2_PIPELINE_FAIL_SOFT
rows.does: A pipeline build that runs out of memory fails on its own instead of ending the session (after run 61 died that way).
rows.evidence: on in about 1,930 runs, never on and off apart; a guard: judge it by its fire line, not speed

rows.name: EDEN_NX2_OOT_MAX_RESOLUTION
rows.does: Game patch: the game takes its own 'dynamic resolution off' path, so it always draws at full size.
rows.evidence: on in about 1,900 runs, never on and off apart; off changes what is drawn, so speed alone cannot judge it

rows.name: EDEN_NX2_UPSCALE_SAME_SIZE
rows.does: Upscale stand-in: a read and a store of the same size count as a pair too.
rows.evidence: on in about 1,880 runs, never on and off apart

rows.name: EDEN_NX2_UPSCALE_SQUARE
rows.does: Upscale stand-in: a packed-float source has each colour squared.
rows.evidence: never fires: 0 'squares its' lines in every T45 to T50 log; it only touches the stand-in copy. Old build: re-check by its line

rows.name: EDEN_NX2_TENSOR
rows.does: The game's matrix (HMMA) shader programs run through one shared software helper ('compact').
rows.evidence: on in about 1,880 runs, never on and off apart

rows.name: EDEN_NX2_TENSOR_ONLY
rows.does: Only the listed matrix program (c00) takes the software path.
rows.evidence: on in about 1,880 runs, never on and off apart; works with EDEN_NX2_TENSOR

rows.name: EDEN_NX2_TENSOR_BACKGROUND

rows.evidence: on in about 1,880 runs, never on and off apart

rows.name: EDEN_NX2_NET_BARRIER
rows.does: Keeps a warp's shared-memory reads and writes in order in the matrix programs.
rows.evidence: on in about 1,880 runs, never on and off apart

rows.name: EDEN_NX2_HANG_WATCH
rows.does: At a GPU stall, names the work that has not finished.
rows.verdict_label: kept: needed for the test logs
rows.evidence: log only; prints only at a stall

rows.name: EDEN_NX2_OOT_DYNAMIC_FPS

rows.evidence: t61-i run328 (T61), one start without it: the script never saw play begin; why was not checked

rows.name: EDEN_NX2_TABLE_POOL_MIB

rows.name: EDEN_NX2_BC_COLLECT_MIB
